message:
docs: a task list of only what is left, and 38 finished documents moved to legacy/2026-09

The task list had not been touched since 09-17 and still carried items closed weeks ago (the
updater replacing itself, the client update button, two in-app trial waits, T1, PICK). It is
rewritten from scratch against main a6cba13 (0.2.133): verification waits that need the user or
the field, code work ordered by felt effect, deploy decisions, record debt, backlog. Nothing that
is finished stays on it.

The September investigations, incidents, audits, refactor plans and closed ledgers move to
docs/legacy/2026-09 with an index; README's read order now starts at the task list. Links in
living docs are rewritten to the new paths; links between moved docs were already relative to
each other and stay valid.

Evidence used for the cut (home host 133 completion at 13:14, PC2 still on 0.2.130, viewer-side
ControlResume absent, server drift being exactly 27d9e74, 133 hash parity) is recorded in the
history entry. Priorities were reviewed with remote_codex in two rounds.
